WITH MatchedProducts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT barcode.ProductID_FK
    FROM Inventory.Data_View_ProductUOMBarcodes AS barcode
    WHERE @searchTerm <> N''
      AND barcode.ProductBarcode = @searchTerm

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT product.ProductID_PK
    FROM Inventory.Data_Products AS product
    WHERE product.ProductID_PK = @productId
       OR (
            @searchTerm <> N''
            AND (
                product.ProductName LIKE N'%' + @searchTerm + N'%'
                OR product.ProductShortName LIKE N'%' + @searchTerm + N'%'
                OR product.ProductCode = @searchTerm
            )
       )
), SourceMovements AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(invoice.SalesInvoiceDate AS date) AS SaleDate,
        item.ProductID_FK AS ProductId,
        item.ProductCode AS ProductCode,
        item.ProductName AS ProductName,
        item.QYT * item.UnitBaseQYT AS BaseQuantity,
        item.SubTotal - ISNULL(item.DiscountAmount, 0) AS NetLineAmount,
        ISNULL(item.DiscountAmount, 0) AS DiscountAmount,
        invoice.SalesInvoiceID_PK AS SalesInvoiceId
    FROM SALES.Data_View_SalesInvoiceItems AS item
    INNER JOIN SALES.Data_View_SalesInvoices AS invoice
        ON invoice.SalesInvoiceID_PK = item.SalesInvoiceID_FK
    INNER JOIN MatchedProducts AS matched
        ON matched.ProductID_FK = item.ProductID_FK
    WHERE invoice.IsPosted = 1
      AND invoice.SalesInvoiceDate >= @startDate
      AND invoice.SalesInvoiceDate < DATEADD(day, 1, @endDate)
), Bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE @granularity
            WHEN N'daily' THEN SaleDate
            WHEN N'weekly' THEN DATEADD(day, (DATEDIFF(day, @startDate, SaleDate) / 7) * 7, @startDate)
            WHEN N'monthly' THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), MONTH(SaleDate), 1)
            WHEN N'yearly' THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), 1, 1)
        END AS PeriodStart,
        CASE @granularity
            WHEN N'daily' THEN SaleDate
            WHEN N'weekly' THEN CASE
                WHEN DATEADD(day, (DATEDIFF(day, @startDate, SaleDate) / 7) * 7 + 6, @startDate) > @endDate THEN @endDate
                ELSE DATEADD(day, (DATEDIFF(day, @startDate, SaleDate) / 7) * 7 + 6, @startDate)
            END
            WHEN N'monthly' THEN CASE
                WHEN EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), MONTH(SaleDate), 1)) > @endDate THEN @endDate
                ELSE EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), MONTH(SaleDate), 1))
            END
            WHEN N'yearly' THEN CASE
                WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), 12, 31) > @endDate THEN @endDate
                ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SaleDate), 12, 31)
            END
        END AS PeriodEnd
    FROM SourceMovements
)
SELECT
    PeriodStart AS periodStart,
    PeriodEnd AS periodEnd,
    ProductId AS productId,
    MAX(ProductCode) AS productCode,
    MAX(ProductName) AS productName,
    SUM(CASE WHEN BaseQuantity > 0 THEN BaseQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS soldBaseQuantity,
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN BaseQuantity < 0 THEN BaseQuantity ELSE 0 END)) AS returnedBaseQuantity,
    SUM(BaseQuantity) AS netBaseQuantity,
    SUM(NetLineAmount) AS netAmount,
    SUM(DiscountAmount) AS discountAmount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SalesInvoiceId) AS invoiceCount
FROM Bucketed
GROUP BY PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, ProductId
HAVING SUM(BaseQuantity) <> 0 OR SUM(NetLineAmount) <> 0
ORDER BY PeriodStart DESC, productName;
